correctness.rationale: After substituting u=1,w=v into the displayed source-package system, the scalar equation is F(v)=v^(k+1)-(theta+1)v^k+(theta+1)v-1. For v≠1, set v=e^(2t), giving theta+1=sinh((k+1)t)/sinh((k-1)t). This ratio is even, strictly increases for t>0 by monotonicity of x*coth(x), tends to (k+1)/(k-1) at zero and diverges, so there is precisely one t>0 above theta=2/(k-1), giving reciprocal solutions. Direct differentiation shows v=1 exactly triple at equality (third derivative k(k+1)); the expansion gives |log(v^k)|=sqrt(6k(k-1)/(k+1))*sqrt(theta-theta_c)+O(delta^(3/2)). Independent symbolic checks for k=2..8 confirm derivatives and coefficient. Boundary-law patterns [1,1,r,r] and [1,1,1/r,1/r] are related by a two-height cyclic shift and common rescaling; within the stated mixed gradient construction this identifies a measure. C verified as a mathematical statement about the package-displayed reduction, while independent full-text authentication of original physical model recurrence remained blocked.
